statement_refuted: A quantitatively nondegenerate rank-two original-coordinate cross block by itself forces a bounded density even when both active coordinate banks retain arbitrary self-curvature.
construction: For iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2] x1,x2,y1,y2, R=(x1+y1)^2-(x2-y2)^2 has cross block I_2, but if h(w)=w^{-1/2}-1 is the density of (x1+y1)^2 then p_R(0)=integral_0^1 h(w)^2 dw=infinity.
target_scope: NOT_A_QFORM_COUNTEREXAMPLE: the coefficient matrix has only two nonzero eigenvalues, 2 and -2.
repair: The same rank-two bicore has the universal half-Riesz bound H_{1/2}(R)<=8(sigma1 sigma2)^(-1/4) by bilateral projected Plancherel. This is spendable by a third product-preserving square/grouped-square packet; a strict-N3 family with spectrum {2,-2,1} is bounded by 8sqrt(2).
